reviewAdvisory: The draft repeatedly attributes policy direction to a named leader ('under Xi Jinping', 'how Xi Jinping steers'), which is political leadership commentary rather than trade-cost analysis and crosses the risk line.

The confidence section asserts there are no figures, yet the body presents illustrative cost arithmetic and scenarios ('raises its export price', 'spread across output') that read as quantified reasoning without any supplied figures, contradicting the stated confidence.
The draft invents a two-scenario cost model with specific production examples that the single Xinhua explainer does not supply, presenting unsupported arithmetic as analysis.
The draft links China's green transformation to specific EU anti-dumping cases without any evidence in the supplied material that the two are connected.
The draft acknowledges a single source but does not include the required explicit single-source disclosure sentence warning readers the analysis rests on one document.
